occupancy_grid — 3D occupancy op

• Data kinds: points → voxel

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.occupancy_grid(points, bounds, res) (to call the implementation directly, import occupancy; occupancy.occupancy_grid(points, bounds, res); from the registry, ops3d.get("occupancy_grid"))

Usage

Point cloud (N,3) → a 3-D occupancy voxel grid, bool (a voxel a point falls into counts as occupied).

bounds=((xmin,xmax),(ymin,ymax),(zmin,zmax)) is the volume spanned by the grid, and res is the number of voxels per axis (scalar = cube res³, or length 3 per axis). Voxels are half-open intervals [lo+i/res*span, lo+(i+1)/res*span), and points at the upper end (frac==1) are included in the last voxel. Points outside bounds are dropped (clamping them to the edge cells would pile phantom obstacles on the boundary). Whereas match3d.points_to_voxel produces a density (float), this one is distinctive in producing occupancy (bool) for planning.

Raises ValueError for res<=0, non-(N,3) points, or degenerate bounds.
